interview.name: Cleo
interview.answer: The repair drive’s time and location aren’t specified in the notes.

reflections: Hana is careful and detail-oriented, asking for the exact repair-drive needs before helping.
Cleo communicates shortages clearly and pragmatically, focusing on a short, concrete list of needed supplies.
Both Hana and Bo respond positively once given specifics, suggesting the requests are well-scoped and easy for others to act on.
The group relies on clear, itemized requests and confirmations for coordinating shared tasks.
People are generally responsive and willing to help by picking up or checking for needed supplies.
The relationship dynamic is practical and collaborative, with repeated follow-through on the same repair-drive needs.
Cleo is coordinating a small group around a practical shared task, and others are responding with concrete offers to help.
Oren needs reminders or a little structure, but he is still willing to contribute and follow through.
Pia values clear logistics and timely updates, especially around pickup/drop-off timing and any changes.
Cleo is coordinating a shared supply effort and keeps responses practical, specific, and appreciative.
Pia values clear logistics and timely updates so she can plan around changes.
Dane, Rey, and Sam are willing to help when given concrete needs and straightforward next steps.
Cleo is coordinating a practical group effort and people respond with concrete help when asked clearly.
Sam and Faye are both willing to contribute supplies, with Sam focused on garage items and Faye also managing schedule constraints.
The conversation is organized around a shared shortage of tape, screws, and basic tools, and Cleo is handling distribution once items arrive.

events.text: Hana: Could you remind me what’s needed for the repair drive, just so I get the details right before I help?
events.speaker: Hana

events.text: Cleo: We’re mostly short on tape, screws, and a few basic tools—nothing too fancy. If you can bring any of those, that’d be a huge help.
events.speaker: Cleo

events.text: Hana: Got it — tape, screws, and a few basic tools. I’ll see what I can bring.
events.speaker: Hana

events.text: Bo: Sounds good — what do you need from me for the repair drive?
